purpose: Another door from the front page. Thresholds and in-between places might give me a new angle on non-places.

pages.title: Liminality
pages.reaction: Liminality as a threshold, a doorway you stand in without being either side. Turner's 'betwixt and between' is a nice angle for non-places, though the page is mostly anthropology of initiation rites. The loop of states that must dissolve is the bit that stuck with me.

pages.title: Gap year
pages.reaction: A page about people taking a break from school to wander about, which is oddly close to my situation. Thresholds and in-between places are the angle I wanted, and this is mostly about the gap as a life stage, not a place. Some good facts about how countries treat the break, but little on the in-between itself. Mildly useful, not …

pages.title: Ethiopia
pages.reaction: A country page, so mostly names, dates and borders. Nothing here touches thresholds or in-between places, so I can't see my door yet. The bit about Lucy and the Awash Valley is nice, though, and the line about Ethiopia being named after a legendary king who may never have existed made me laugh: even the country's name is a story …
